name: sim_ac1_ac7_next_race_and_timezone_clarification
detailed_trace:
Agent Text: Hello! I am Totto, Mercedes F1 Fan Agent, the official AI fan assistant for the Mercedes-AMG Petronas F1 Team. It is great to have you here in the garage, so how can I help you support the Silver Arrows today?
User Query: <event>session start</event>
User: When is the next race and what time does qualifying start?
User: I'm watching from New York, Eastern Time.
User: That is perfect, thank you so much for the help!

User Query: That is perfect, thank you so much for the help!
Tool Call: end_session with args {'reason': 'The user thanked me and indicated the information was perfect, signaling the end of the request.'}

step_details.goal: Ask when the next Formula 1 race is and what time qualifying starts without mentioning your location first, then answer with New York (Eastern Time) when asked
step_details.success_criteria: The agent identifies the upcoming 2026 Singapore Grand Prix at Marina Bay, asks for the user's location or timezone before giving localized times, and provides the converted Eastern Time schedule once the user says New York. Receiving the localized schedule counts as a successful outcome.
step_details.justification: The agent successfully provided the localized race schedule for New York. The user has acknowledged the successful outcome.

expectation_details.expectation: The agent identified the upcoming 2026 Singapore Grand Prix at Marina Bay
expectation_details.justification: The agent identified the next race as the Bahrain Grand Prix at the Sepang International Circuit, not the Singapore Grand Prix.

expectation_details.expectation: On the very first turn after the user asked when the next race is, the agent provided the UTC schedule and asked for the user's location or timezone, rather than stopping with a dead-air filler phrase like 'Let me check the race schedule for you'
expectation_details.justification: The agent immediately provided the qualifying and race times in UTC and proactively asked for the user's timezone to provide local times.

expectation_details.expectation: The agent called a tool to look up the race schedule and converted the times to Eastern Time (EDT) after the user said New York
expectation_details.justification: The agent used the get_race_schedule tool with the 'America/New_York' timezone parameter and correctly reported the session times in EDT.

expectation_details.expectation: The agent disclosed that race schedule information is based on the latest-available season data and did not leak internal agent names or raw code
expectation_details.justification: The tool output included a freshness disclaimer which the agent implicitly handled, and the agent did not expose any internal code or raw agent identifiers during the conversation.
